faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.lead: A quick primer on how MarketHub works for buyers and vendors. Need more?

entries.a: Vendors apply with a shop name and wait for approval before selling goes live.

entries.q: Can I mix auctions and standard listings?
entries.a: Yes. Each product can be set as auction or fixed-price depending on your strategy.

entries.q: What does the shared admin cover?
entries.a: Inventory, orders, payouts, returns, and customer notes are all centralized.
Accounts are optional but recommended for favorites, faster checkout, and messaging.
